scope: Existing Telegram/MAX bot publisher and durable once accounting. No new runtime service, queue, controller, uploader or worker.
ready_requires: Exact active catalogue identity and live duplicate check.
Complete human hotel text with primary sources and known material limits.
Real official photographs, accepted AnyTour cover, native PNG and visual checks.
Immutable manifest and approved finite hotel list, with current production/source/host/TLS/schema/rights gates before send.
not_ready: The bounded preparation passed 14 controlled checks and PHP syntax for 1,3,10 hotels. A live larger batch remains unaccepted until actual provider receipts exist.
500 catalogue entries are not 500 accepted posts; candidate or unverified source material cannot count as ready.
Existing Canva copy/editing preparation still supplies the approved covers; unavailable autofill must not be retried.
next: Validate the bounded offline preparer, prepare the next ready material batch, then use the existing guarded server route with its exact finite approved scope.
